Subject: Renewal kickoff — Spectra Analytics: term options, QBR window & next steps

Hi Alex / Maya —

Congrats on completing year two with Redwood. We wanted to kick off the renewal conversation and align on the things we'll cover so your team has predictable capacity and the pricing/term flexibility you asked about.

Quick agenda (15–20 min):
- Confirm renewal date & target term length (12 vs 24 months)
- Review proposed capacity uplift and burst runway
- Outline pricing bands and optional committed tiers
- Schedule a QBR to present the performance & cost analysis
- Identify exec & procurement stakeholders and next steps for legal

Proposed timeline:
- This week: alignment call + confirm stakeholders (you)
- Week of Oct 23: internal pricing review and draft amendment
- Week of Oct 30: QBR + finalize term & DocuSign

I've attached a short proposal and an initial mutual action plan to help move quickly. Can you share who from procurement should be included and two 30–45 min windows that work for a kickoff this week?

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Senior Account Manager, Renewals
Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): spectra_proposal_v3.pdf (PDF), mutual_action_plan_spectra.xlsx (Excel)

Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff — Spectra Analytics: term options, QBR window & next steps

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the clear plan. Procurement is copied (procurement@spectra-analytics.com) — that's our centralized vendor inbox. For the kickoff, Maya and I can do:
- Wed Oct 11, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Thu Oct 12, 14:00–14:45 PT

Two quick notes:
- We're leaning toward a 24-month term if we can get a modest step-down on unit price at year 2.
- On capacity, our analytics batch jobs will increase in January; we'd likely need a 35–40% committed uplift in the first quarter of 2029 with an ability to burst beyond that.

Please confirm which slot works and whether you need any usage telemetry ahead of the QBR.

Cheers,
Alex
Head of Engineering Operations
Spectra Analytics

Thanks — prepping the deck now. Draft plan:
1) 5m intro + renewal objectives (So we & Spectra align)
2) 10m usage & performance highlights (include 90-day peaks + cost per 1k tokens by model)
3) 10m uplift scenarios:
   - Option A: 12m, +20% committed, nominal pricing change
   - Option B: 24m, +40% committed, year-2 unit step-down 7%
   - Option C: 24m + burst buffer (prepaid credits) for Q1 2029
4) 5m next steps & procurement timing

Dev — can you confirm the 90-day peak and attach the CSV? If we have a short TTL burst report, include that as a slide. Rishi — I'll call out the two recommended commercial options and highlight the likely approval path for a 24m with step-down.

I'll send a draft deck by EOD Oct 16 for Soojin to review.
